+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None
+

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {"searches": searches, "packages": packages, "unresolved_candidates": unresolved}
+

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return sorted(set(re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)))
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {"searches": searches, "packages": packages, "unresolved_candidates": unresolved}

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return sorted(set(re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)))
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {"searches": searches, "packages": packages, "unresolved_candidates": unresolved}
+

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None
+

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {"searches": searches, "packages": packages, "unresolved_candidates": unresolved}
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:

+                }
+            )

+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None
+

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {"searches": searches, "packages": packages, "unresolved_candidates": unresolved}
+

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {"searches": searches, "packages": packages, "unresolved_candidates": unresolved}
+

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None
+

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {"searches": searches, "packages": packages, "unresolved_candidates": unresolved}
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []

+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):

+공식 경로는 [MiniSat 저장소](https://github.com/niklasso/minisat), [CaDiCaL 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/cadical/releases), [Kissat 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/kissat/releases), [CryptoMiniSat 릴리스](https://github.com/msoos/cryptominisat/releases)다. `sat-solvers.txt`의 `candidate_specs`는 후보 ID와 후보 이름을 구별한다. 각 명세는 발견 출처, 패키지 조회 이름, 실행 파일 탐색 방법, 버전 명령, DIMACS 호출 방식, 대체 수단, 갱신 트리거를 갖는다.
+
+`candidate_discovery.searches`는 실행 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 명령·exit code·stdout·stderr·발견 출처를 기록한다. `candidate_discovery.candidates`는 명세별 조회와 패키지 ID를 같은 후보 ID에 연결한다. `unresolved_candidates`가 비어 있지 않으면 `candidate_status`는 `FAIL`이다. 실행 메타데이터가 없는 발견 후보는 미결로 남는다.

+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]
+
+
+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+
+
+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None
+
+
+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {"searches": searches, "packages": packages, "unresolved_candidates": unresolved}
+
+

 ## 5. SAT 실행 파일 판정표
 
-공식 경로는 [MiniSat 저장소](https://github.com/niklasso/minisat), [CaDiCaL 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/cadical/releases), [Kissat 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/kissat/releases), [CryptoMiniSat 릴리스](https://github.com/msoos/cryptominisat/releases)다. 실행 가능한 기존 `winget`으로 최소 후보 4종을 전건 조회했다. 조회 중 추가 SAT 후보는 발견하지 못했다.
+공식 경로는 [MiniSat 저장소](https://github.com/niklasso/minisat), [CaDiCaL 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/cadical/releases), [Kissat 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/kissat/releases), [CryptoMiniSat 릴리스](https://github.com/msoos/cryptominisat/releases)다. `sat-solvers.txt`의 `candidate_specs`는 후보 ID와 후보 이름을 구별한다. 각 명세는 발견 출처, 패키지 조회 이름, 실행 파일 탐색 방법, 버전 명령, DIMACS 호출 방식, 대체 수단, 갱신 트리거를 갖는다.
+
+`candidate_discovery.searches`는 실행 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 명령·exit code·stdout·stderr·발견 출처를 기록한다. `candidate_discovery.candidates`는 명세별 조회와 패키지 ID를 같은 후보 ID에 연결한다. `unresolved_candidates`가 비어 있지 않으면 `candidate_status`는 `FAIL`이다. 실행 메타데이터가 없는 발견 후보는 미결로 남는다.

+    if manager == "winget":

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():

+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }

+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(

+                    "package_id": package_id,

+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {"searches": searches, "packages": packages, "unresolved_candidates": unresolved}

 ## 5. SAT 실행 파일 판정표
 
-공식 경로는 [MiniSat 저장소](https://github.com/niklasso/minisat), [CaDiCaL 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/cadical/releases), [Kissat 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/kissat/releases), [CryptoMiniSat 릴리스](https://github.com/msoos/cryptominisat/releases)다. 실행 가능한 기존 `winget`으로 최소 후보 4종을 전건 조회했다. 조회 중 추가 SAT 후보는 발견하지 못했다.
+공식 경로는 [MiniSat 저장소](https://github.com/niklasso/minisat), [CaDiCaL 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/cadical/releases), [Kissat 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/kissat/releases), [CryptoMiniSat 릴리스](https://github.com/msoos/cryptominisat/releases)다. `sat-solvers.txt`의 `candidate_specs`는 후보 ID와 후보 이름을 구별한다. 각 명세는 발견 출처, 패키지 조회 이름, 실행 파일 탐색 방법, 버전 명령, DIMACS 호출 방식, 대체 수단, 갱신 트리거를 갖는다.
+
+`candidate_discovery.searches`는 실행 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 명령·exit code·stdout·stderr·발견 출처를 기록한다. `candidate_discovery.candidates`는 명세별 조회와 패키지 ID를 같은 후보 ID에 연결한다. `unresolved_candidates`가 비어 있지 않으면 `candidate_status`는 `FAIL`이다. 실행 메타데이터가 없는 발견 후보는 미결로 남는다.

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:

+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)

+                }

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {"searches": searches, "packages": packages, "unresolved_candidates": unresolved}

+    if manager == "winget":

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []

+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)

+                }
+            )

+공식 경로는 [MiniSat 저장소](https://github.com/niklasso/minisat), [CaDiCaL 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/cadical/releases), [Kissat 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/kissat/releases), [CryptoMiniSat 릴리스](https://github.com/msoos/cryptominisat/releases)다. `sat-solvers.txt`의 `candidate_specs`는 후보 ID와 후보 이름을 구별한다. 각 명세는 발견 출처, 패키지 조회 이름, 실행 파일 탐색 방법, 버전 명령, DIMACS 호출 방식, 대체 수단, 갱신 트리거를 갖는다.

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue

+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(

+                    "package_id": package_id,

+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {"searches": searches, "packages": packages, "unresolved_candidates": unresolved}

+            }

+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {"searches": searches, "packages": packages, "unresolved_candidates": unresolved}

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None
+

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {"searches": searches, "packages": packages, "unresolved_candidates": unresolved}

+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]
+
+
+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+
+
+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None
+
+
+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {"searches": searches, "packages": packages, "unresolved_candidates": unresolved}
+

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None
+

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {"searches": searches, "packages": packages, "unresolved_candidates": unresolved}
+

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )

+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+
+
+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None
+

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(search["exit_code"] == 0 for search in searches),
+    }
+

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(search["exit_code"] == 0 for search in searches),
+    }

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(search["exit_code"] == 0 for search in searches),
+    }
+

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(search["exit_code"] == 0 for search in searches),
+    }
+

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None
+

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(search["exit_code"] == 0 for search in searches),
+    }
+

 ## 5. SAT 실행 파일 판정표
 
-공식 경로는 [MiniSat 저장소](https://github.com/niklasso/minisat), [CaDiCaL 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/cadical/releases), [Kissat 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/kissat/releases), [CryptoMiniSat 릴리스](https://github.com/msoos/cryptominisat/releases)다. 실행 가능한 기존 `winget`으로 최소 후보 4종을 전건 조회했다. 조회 중 추가 SAT 후보는 발견하지 못했다.
+공식 경로는 [MiniSat 저장소](https://github.com/niklasso/minisat), [CaDiCaL 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/cadical/releases), [Kissat 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/kissat/releases), [CryptoMiniSat 릴리스](https://github.com/msoos/cryptominisat/releases)다. `sat-solvers.txt`의 `candidate_specs`는 후보 ID와 후보 이름을 구별한다. 각 명세는 발견 출처, 패키지 조회 이름, 실행 파일 탐색 방법, 버전 명령, DIMACS 호출 방식, 대체 수단, 갱신 트리거를 갖는다.

+`candidate_discovery.searches`는 실행 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 명령·exit code·stdout·stderr·발견 출처를 기록한다. `candidate_discovery.candidates`는 명세별 조회와 패키지 ID를 같은 후보 ID에 연결한다. `unresolved_candidates`가 비어 있지 않으면 `candidate_status`는 `FAIL`이다. 실행 메타데이터가 없는 발견 후보는 미결로 남는다.

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )

+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None
+

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(search["exit_code"] == 0 for search in searches),
+    }
+

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]
+

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+
+
+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None
+

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(search["exit_code"] == 0 for search in searches),
+    }
+

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(search["exit_code"] == 0 for search in searches),
+    }

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]
+
+
+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+
+
+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None
+

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(search["exit_code"] == 0 for search in searches),
+    }
+

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]
+

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+
+
+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None
+

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(search["exit_code"] == 0 for search in searches),
+    }
+
