 ## 5. SAT 실행 파일 판정표
 
-공식 경로는 [MiniSat 저장소](https://github.com/niklasso/minisat), [CaDiCaL 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/cadical/releases), [Kissat 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/kissat/releases), [CryptoMiniSat 릴리스](https://github.com/msoos/cryptominisat/releases)다. 실행 가능한 기존 `winget`으로 최소 후보 4종을 전건 조회했다. 조회 중 추가 SAT 후보는 발견하지 못했다.
+공식 경로는 [MiniSat 저장소](https://github.com/niklasso/minisat), [CaDiCaL 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/cadical/releases), [Kissat 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/kissat/releases), [CryptoMiniSat 릴리스](https://github.com/msoos/cryptominisat/releases)다. `sat-solvers.txt`의 `candidate_specs`는 후보 ID와 후보 이름을 구별한다. 각 명세는 발견 출처, 패키지 조회 이름, 실행 파일 탐색 방법, 버전 명령, DIMACS 호출 방식, 대체 수단, 갱신 트리거를 갖는다.
+
+`candidate_discovery.searches`는 실행 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 명령·exit code·stdout·stderr·발견 출처를 기록한다. `candidate_discovery.candidates`는 명세별 조회와 패키지 ID를 같은 후보 ID에 연결한다. `unresolved_candidates`가 비어 있지 않으면 `candidate_status`는 `FAIL`이다. 실행 메타데이터가 없는 발견 후보는 미결로 남는다.
 
 | 판정 ID | 도구 | 공식 배포 경로 | 사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리 경로 | 확보 가능성 | 설치 시도 | 버전 | SAT·UNSAT DIMACS 스모크 | 상태 | 대체 수단 | 갱신 트리거 |
 |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

-`toolchain_smoke.py`는 매 실행에서 import, 패키지 관리자, 후보별 조회, 실행 파일을 다시 호출한다. `collect_report()`와 `--json`은 같은 객체를 쓴다. `sat-solvers.txt`는 같은 solver 행을 쓴다. 세 라이브 로그는 과거 사건을 담지 않는다. `environment-changes.json`만 과거 사건을 담는다.
+`toolchain_smoke.py`는 매 실행에서 import, 패키지 관리자, 광범위 후보 발견, 후보별 조회, 실행 파일을 다시 호출한다. `collect_report()`와 `--json`은 같은 후보 명세와 후보 발견 결과를 쓴다. `sat-solvers.txt`는 같은 후보 ID로 명세, 해소 상태, 조회, 설치 대상, 측정 결과를 쓴다.
+
+`environment-changes.json`의 SAT 설치 사건은 `package_manager`, `package_id`, `command`, `exit_code`, `stdout`, `stderr`를 갖는다. 설치가 실패하면 사건은 `error`, `fallback`, `refresh_trigger`, `status: FAIL`로 완결한다. 설치 시도 뒤의 `remeasurement`는 같은 후보 명세로 실행 파일, 버전, SAT DIMACS, UNSAT DIMACS를 다시 측정한다. 세 라이브 로그는 `recorded_event`를 담지 않는다.

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(search["exit_code"] == 0 for search in searches),
+    }

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(search["exit_code"] == 0 for search in searches),
+    }

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(search["exit_code"] == 0 for search in searches),
+    }

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(

+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):

+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""

+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {

+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(search["exit_code"] == 0 for search in searches),
+    }

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {

+            }

+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(search["exit_code"] == 0 for search in searches),
+    }

+    executable_spec = spec["executable"]
+    fallback_value = executable_spec.get("fallback_path")
+    fallback = Path(_invocation_executable(fallback_value)) if fallback_value else None
+    if executable_spec["search"] == "PATH_then_winget_package" and discovery_row.get("package_id"):
+        fallback = _installed_winget_executable(discovery_row["package_id"], executable_spec["name"])
+    executable = _find_executable(executable_spec["name"], fallback)
+    if spec["dimacs_invocation"]["kind"] != "file_argument":
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported DIMACS invocation for {candidate_id}")
+    row = _solver_row(candidate_id, executable, spec["version_command"], "dimacs")
+    row.update(
+        {
+            "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+            "candidate_name": spec["candidate_name"],
+            "candidate_spec": spec,
+            "discovery": discovery_row,
+            "fallback": spec["fallback"],
+            "refresh_trigger": spec["refresh_trigger"],
+        }
+    )
+    return row

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]

+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+
+
+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None
+

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }
+

+공식 경로는 [MiniSat 저장소](https://github.com/niklasso/minisat), [CaDiCaL 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/cadical/releases), [Kissat 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/kissat/releases), [CryptoMiniSat 릴리스](https://github.com/msoos/cryptominisat/releases)다. `sat-solvers.txt`의 `candidate_specs`는 후보 ID와 후보 이름을 구별한다. 각 명세는 발견 출처, 패키지 조회 이름, 실행 파일 탐색 방법, 버전 명령, DIMACS 호출 방식, 대체 수단, 갱신 트리거를 갖는다.
+
+`candidate_discovery.searches`는 실행 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 명령·exit code·stdout·stderr·발견 출처를 기록한다. `candidate_discovery.candidates`는 명세별 조회와 패키지 ID를 같은 후보 ID에 연결한다. `unresolved_candidates`가 비어 있지 않으면 `candidate_status`는 `FAIL`이다. 실행 메타데이터가 없는 발견 후보는 미결로 남는다.

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]

+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

+공식 경로는 [MiniSat 저장소](https://github.com/niklasso/minisat), [CaDiCaL 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/cadical/releases), [Kissat 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/kissat/releases), [CryptoMiniSat 릴리스](https://github.com/msoos/cryptominisat/releases)다. `sat-solvers.txt`의 `candidate_specs`는 후보 ID와 후보 이름을 구별한다. 각 명세는 발견 출처, 패키지 조회 이름, 실행 파일 탐색 방법, 버전 명령, DIMACS 호출 방식, 대체 수단, 갱신 트리거를 갖는다.

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]

+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

 ## 5. SAT 실행 파일 판정표
 
-공식 경로는 [MiniSat 저장소](https://github.com/niklasso/minisat), [CaDiCaL 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/cadical/releases), [Kissat 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/kissat/releases), [CryptoMiniSat 릴리스](https://github.com/msoos/cryptominisat/releases)다. 실행 가능한 기존 `winget`으로 최소 후보 4종을 전건 조회했다. 조회 중 추가 SAT 후보는 발견하지 못했다.
+공식 경로는 [MiniSat 저장소](https://github.com/niklasso/minisat), [CaDiCaL 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/cadical/releases), [Kissat 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/kissat/releases), [CryptoMiniSat 릴리스](https://github.com/msoos/cryptominisat/releases)다. `sat-solvers.txt`의 `candidate_specs`는 후보 ID와 후보 이름을 구별한다. 각 명세는 발견 출처, 패키지 조회 이름, 실행 파일 탐색 방법, 버전 명령, DIMACS 호출 방식, 대체 수단, 갱신 트리거를 갖는다.
+
+`candidate_discovery.searches`는 실행 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 명령·exit code·stdout·stderr·발견 출처를 기록한다. `candidate_discovery.candidates`는 명세별 조회와 패키지 ID를 같은 후보 ID에 연결한다. `unresolved_candidates`가 비어 있지 않으면 `candidate_status`는 `FAIL`이다. 실행 메타데이터가 없는 발견 후보는 미결로 남는다.
 
 | 판정 ID | 도구 | 공식 배포 경로 | 사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리 경로 | 확보 가능성 | 설치 시도 | 버전 | SAT·UNSAT DIMACS 스모크 | 상태 | 대체 수단 | 갱신 트리거 |
 |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

+`toolchain_smoke.py`는 매 실행에서 import, 패키지 관리자, 광범위 후보 발견, 후보별 조회, 실행 파일을 다시 호출한다. `collect_report()`와 `--json`은 같은 후보 명세와 후보 발견 결과를 쓴다. `sat-solvers.txt`는 같은 후보 ID로 명세, 해소 상태, 조회, 설치 대상, 측정 결과를 쓴다.
+
+`environment-changes.json`의 SAT 설치 사건은 `package_manager`, `package_id`, `command`, `exit_code`, `stdout`, `stderr`를 갖는다. 설치가 실패하면 사건은 `error`, `fallback`, `refresh_trigger`, `status: FAIL`로 완결한다. 설치 시도 뒤의 `remeasurement`는 같은 후보 명세로 실행 파일, 버전, SAT DIMACS, UNSAT DIMACS를 다시 측정한다. 세 라이브 로그는 `recorded_event`를 담지 않는다.

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""

+`toolchain_smoke.py`는 매 실행에서 import, 패키지 관리자, 광범위 후보 발견, 후보별 조회, 실행 파일을 다시 호출한다. `collect_report()`와 `--json`은 같은 후보 명세와 후보 발견 결과를 쓴다. `sat-solvers.txt`는 같은 후보 ID로 명세, 해소 상태, 조회, 설치 대상, 측정 결과를 쓴다.
+
+`environment-changes.json`의 SAT 설치 사건은 `package_manager`, `package_id`, `command`, `exit_code`, `stdout`, `stderr`를 갖는다. 설치가 실패하면 사건은 `error`, `fallback`, `refresh_trigger`, `status: FAIL`로 완결한다. 설치 시도 뒤의 `remeasurement`는 같은 후보 명세로 실행 파일, 버전, SAT DIMACS, UNSAT DIMACS를 다시 측정한다. 세 라이브 로그는 `recorded_event`를 담지 않는다.

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:

+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(

+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {

+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+
+
+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None
+

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }

+    if manager == "winget":

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

+공식 경로는 [MiniSat 저장소](https://github.com/niklasso/minisat), [CaDiCaL 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/cadical/releases), [Kissat 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/kissat/releases), [CryptoMiniSat 릴리스](https://github.com/msoos/cryptominisat/releases)다. `sat-solvers.txt`의 `candidate_specs`는 후보 ID와 후보 이름을 구별한다. 각 명세는 발견 출처, 패키지 조회 이름, 실행 파일 탐색 방법, 버전 명령, DIMACS 호출 방식, 대체 수단, 갱신 트리거를 갖는다.
+

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

+공식 경로는 [MiniSat 저장소](https://github.com/niklasso/minisat), [CaDiCaL 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/cadical/releases), [Kissat 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/kissat/releases), [CryptoMiniSat 릴리스](https://github.com/msoos/cryptominisat/releases)다. `sat-solvers.txt`의 `candidate_specs`는 후보 ID와 후보 이름을 구별한다. 각 명세는 발견 출처, 패키지 조회 이름, 실행 파일 탐색 방법, 버전 명령, DIMACS 호출 방식, 대체 수단, 갱신 트리거를 갖는다.
+
+`candidate_discovery.searches`는 실행 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 명령·exit code·stdout·stderr·발견 출처를 기록한다. `candidate_discovery.candidates`는 명세별 조회와 패키지 ID를 같은 후보 ID에 연결한다. `unresolved_candidates`가 비어 있지 않으면 `candidate_status`는 `FAIL`이다. 실행 메타데이터가 없는 발견 후보는 미결로 남는다.

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():

+            continue

+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)

+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(

+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {

+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(

+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

-`toolchain_smoke.py`는 매 실행에서 import, 패키지 관리자, 후보별 조회, 실행 파일을 다시 호출한다. `collect_report()`와 `--json`은 같은 객체를 쓴다. `sat-solvers.txt`는 같은 solver 행을 쓴다. 세 라이브 로그는 과거 사건을 담지 않는다. `environment-changes.json`만 과거 사건을 담는다.
+`toolchain_smoke.py`는 매 실행에서 import, 패키지 관리자, 광범위 후보 발견, 후보별 조회, 실행 파일을 다시 호출한다. `collect_report()`와 `--json`은 같은 후보 명세와 후보 발견 결과를 쓴다. `sat-solvers.txt`는 같은 후보 ID로 명세, 해소 상태, 조회, 설치 대상, 측정 결과를 쓴다.
+
+`environment-changes.json`의 SAT 설치 사건은 `package_manager`, `package_id`, `command`, `exit_code`, `stdout`, `stderr`를 갖는다. 설치가 실패하면 사건은 `error`, `fallback`, `refresh_trigger`, `status: FAIL`로 완결한다. 설치 시도 뒤의 `remeasurement`는 같은 후보 명세로 실행 파일, 버전, SAT DIMACS, UNSAT DIMACS를 다시 측정한다. 세 라이브 로그는 `recorded_event`를 담지 않는다.

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue

+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""

+        search = {

+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",

+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]

+`toolchain_smoke.py`는 매 실행에서 import, 패키지 관리자, 광범위 후보 발견, 후보별 조회, 실행 파일을 다시 호출한다. `collect_report()`와 `--json`은 같은 후보 명세와 후보 발견 결과를 쓴다. `sat-solvers.txt`는 같은 후보 ID로 명세, 해소 상태, 조회, 설치 대상, 측정 결과를 쓴다.
+
+`environment-changes.json`의 SAT 설치 사건은 `package_manager`, `package_id`, `command`, `exit_code`, `stdout`, `stderr`를 갖는다. 설치가 실패하면 사건은 `error`, `fallback`, `refresh_trigger`, `status: FAIL`로 완결한다. 설치 시도 뒤의 `remeasurement`는 같은 후보 명세로 실행 파일, 버전, SAT DIMACS, UNSAT DIMACS를 다시 측정한다. 세 라이브 로그는 `recorded_event`를 담지 않는다.

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+
+
+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None
+
+
+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }
+

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }

+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }
