+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {

+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )

+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""

+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

+## 이월 사슬
+
+`2.6.9.5.3`은 합성 후보와 설치 실패 결선을 독립 검증한다. `2.6.6`은 라이브 증거로 S1을 재측정한다.
+
+## 잔여·처분
+
+라이브 광범위 탐색에서 추가 패키지는 0건이었다. `cadical`과 `kissat`은 실행 파일이 없어 FAIL이다. `minisat` 설치 시도는 업그레이드가 없어 FAIL이지만, 설치된 실행 파일의 재측정은 PASS다. 신규 패키지 관리자·WSL·컨테이너·소스 빌드는 없다.
+
+## 반증 의무
+
+합성 후보 GREEN은 임의의 실제 패키지 출력을 전부 해소한다는 근거가 아니다. 라이브 탐색은 추가 패키지를 반환하지 않았다. 따라서 후속 환경의 미해소 패키지가 전체 FAIL을 내는지 `2.6.9.5.3`이 독립 검증해야 한다. 그 밖의 파견문·정본과 어긋난 사실은 없음.

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }
+

+| 소비자 | `_measure_sat_candidate()`, `collect_report()`, `install_available_sat_candidates()`, `main()`, `--json`, `sat-solvers.txt`, `test_toolchain_smoke.py`, `toolchain-baseline.md` 5·6절 |
+
+합성 `synthetic_sat`는 후보 이름, 발견 출처, 조회, `Example.synthetic-sat`, 확보 가능성, 설치 사건, 실행 파일 재탐색, 버전, SAT, UNSAT, JSON, `sat-solvers.txt`에서 같은 후보 ID를 유지했다.
+
+## D. 라이브 발견·설치 증거
+
+- 로컬 패키지 관리자: `winget` 가용 1건, `choco`·`scoop` 비가용.
+- 광범위 탐색: 명령 1건, 발견 패키지 0건, 미해소 0건, `candidate_status: PASS`.
+- 설치 대상: `minisat` 1건. 사건 exit code는 2316632107이고 `status: FAIL`이다.
+- 설치 사건 필드: `package_manager`, `package_id`, `command`, `exit_code`, `stdout`, `stderr` 전건 존재.
+- 실패 완결: `error`, `fallback`, `refresh_trigger`, `status: FAIL` 전건 존재.
+- 재측정: 실행 파일·버전·SAT·UNSAT 전건 실행, `status: PASS`.

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []

+        search = {

+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,

+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(

+                    "package_id": package_id,

+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {

+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

+`toolchain_smoke.py`는 매 실행에서 import, 패키지 관리자, 광범위 후보 발견, 후보별 조회, 실행 파일을 다시 호출한다. `collect_report()`와 `--json`은 같은 후보 명세와 후보 발견 결과를 쓴다. `sat-solvers.txt`는 같은 후보 ID로 명세, 해소 상태, 조회, 설치 대상, 측정 결과를 쓴다.

+`environment-changes.json`의 SAT 설치 사건은 `package_manager`, `package_id`, `command`, `exit_code`, `stdout`, `stderr`를 갖는다. 설치가 실패하면 사건은 `error`, `fallback`, `refresh_trigger`, `status: FAIL`로 완결한다. 설치 시도 뒤의 `remeasurement`는 같은 후보 명세로 실행 파일, 버전, SAT DIMACS, UNSAT DIMACS를 다시 측정한다. 세 라이브 로그는 `recorded_event`를 담지 않는다.

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

+## D. 라이브 발견·설치 증거

+- 광범위 탐색: 명령 1건, 발견 패키지 0건, 미해소 0건, `candidate_status: PASS`.
+- 설치 대상: `minisat` 1건. 사건 exit code는 2316632107이고 `status: FAIL`이다.
+- 설치 사건 필드: `package_manager`, `package_id`, `command`, `exit_code`, `stdout`, `stderr` 전건 존재.
+- 실패 완결: `error`, `fallback`, `refresh_trigger`, `status: FAIL` 전건 존재.
+- 재측정: 실행 파일·버전·SAT·UNSAT 전건 실행, `status: PASS`.

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue

+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

 | `python experiments/pvsnp/smoke/test_toolchain_smoke.py` | 테스트 stdout의 시험 건수와 `OK` | 새 구조의 생산자·소비자와 증거 종류 경계 |
 
-`toolchain_smoke.py`는 매 실행에서 import, 패키지 관리자, 후보별 조회, 실행 파일을 다시 호출한다. `collect_report()`와 `--json`은 같은 객체를 쓴다. `sat-solvers.txt`는 같은 solver 행을 쓴다. 세 라이브 로그는 과거 사건을 담지 않는다. `environment-changes.json`만 과거 사건을 담는다.
+`toolchain_smoke.py`는 매 실행에서 import, 패키지 관리자, 광범위 후보 발견, 후보별 조회, 실행 파일을 다시 호출한다. `collect_report()`와 `--json`은 같은 후보 명세와 후보 발견 결과를 쓴다. `sat-solvers.txt`는 같은 후보 ID로 명세, 해소 상태, 조회, 설치 대상, 측정 결과를 쓴다.
+
+`environment-changes.json`의 SAT 설치 사건은 `package_manager`, `package_id`, `command`, `exit_code`, `stdout`, `stderr`를 갖는다. 설치가 실패하면 사건은 `error`, `fallback`, `refresh_trigger`, `status: FAIL`로 완결한다. 설치 시도 뒤의 `remeasurement`는 같은 후보 명세로 실행 파일, 버전, SAT DIMACS, UNSAT DIMACS를 다시 측정한다. 세 라이브 로그는 `recorded_event`를 담지 않는다.

+def _broad_discovery_command(manager: str, executable: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [executable, "search", "--query", "SAT solver", "--source", "winget", "--accept-source-agreements", "--disable-interactivity"]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", "sat solver", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", "sat"]

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

+| 소비자 | `_measure_sat_candidate()`, `collect_report()`, `install_available_sat_candidates()`, `main()`, `--json`, `sat-solvers.txt`, `test_toolchain_smoke.py`, `toolchain-baseline.md` 5·6절 |
+
+합성 `synthetic_sat`는 후보 이름, 발견 출처, 조회, `Example.synthetic-sat`, 확보 가능성, 설치 사건, 실행 파일 재탐색, 버전, SAT, UNSAT, JSON, `sat-solvers.txt`에서 같은 후보 ID를 유지했다.
+
+## D. 라이브 발견·설치 증거
+
+- 로컬 패키지 관리자: `winget` 가용 1건, `choco`·`scoop` 비가용.
+- 광범위 탐색: 명령 1건, 발견 패키지 0건, 미해소 0건, `candidate_status: PASS`.
+- 설치 대상: `minisat` 1건. 사건 exit code는 2316632107이고 `status: FAIL`이다.
+- 설치 사건 필드: `package_manager`, `package_id`, `command`, `exit_code`, `stdout`, `stderr` 전건 존재.
+- 실패 완결: `error`, `fallback`, `refresh_trigger`, `status: FAIL` 전건 존재.
+- 재측정: 실행 파일·버전·SAT·UNSAT 전건 실행, `status: PASS`.

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))
+

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue

+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

-`toolchain_smoke.py`는 매 실행에서 import, 패키지 관리자, 후보별 조회, 실행 파일을 다시 호출한다. `collect_report()`와 `--json`은 같은 객체를 쓴다. `sat-solvers.txt`는 같은 solver 행을 쓴다. 세 라이브 로그는 과거 사건을 담지 않는다. `environment-changes.json`만 과거 사건을 담는다.
+`toolchain_smoke.py`는 매 실행에서 import, 패키지 관리자, 광범위 후보 발견, 후보별 조회, 실행 파일을 다시 호출한다. `collect_report()`와 `--json`은 같은 후보 명세와 후보 발견 결과를 쓴다. `sat-solvers.txt`는 같은 후보 ID로 명세, 해소 상태, 조회, 설치 대상, 측정 결과를 쓴다.
+
+`environment-changes.json`의 SAT 설치 사건은 `package_manager`, `package_id`, `command`, `exit_code`, `stdout`, `stderr`를 갖는다. 설치가 실패하면 사건은 `error`, `fallback`, `refresh_trigger`, `status: FAIL`로 완결한다. 설치 시도 뒤의 `remeasurement`는 같은 후보 명세로 실행 파일, 버전, SAT DIMACS, UNSAT DIMACS를 다시 측정한다. 세 라이브 로그는 `recorded_event`를 담지 않는다.

+    @staticmethod

+        specs = dict(toolchain_smoke.SAT_CANDIDATE_SPECS)
+        specs["synthetic_sat"] = {

+            "candidate_name": "Synthetic SAT",
+            "discovery_sources": ["synthetic_test"],

+            "executable": {"name": "synthetic-sat", "search": "PATH", "fallback_path": None},
+            "version_command": ["--version"],
+            "dimacs_invocation": {"kind": "file_argument"},
+            "fallback": "PySAT Minisat22",
+            "refresh_trigger": "synthetic package changes",
+        }
+        return specs
+
+    def test_synthetic_fifth_candidate_remeasurement_uses_candidate_specification(self):
+        synthetic = self.synthetic_specs()["synthetic_sat"]
+        discovery = {
+            "candidate_id": "synthetic_sat",
+            "resolution_status": "resolved",
+            "package_queries": [],
+            "available": False,
+            "package_manager": None,
+            "package_id": None,
+        }
+        measured = {
+            "name": "synthetic_sat",
+            "status": "PASS",
+            "version": {"command": "synthetic-sat --version", "exit_code": 0},
+            "sat": {"command": "synthetic-sat sat.cnf", "exit_code": 10},
+            "unsat": {"command": "synthetic-sat unsat.cnf", "exit_code": 20},
+        }
+        with mock.patch.object(toolchain_smoke, "_find_executable", return_value="synthetic-sat"), mock.patch.object(
+            toolchain_smoke, "_solver_row", return_value=measured
+        ):
+            result = toolchain_smoke._measure_sat_candidate(synthetic, discovery)
+        self.assertEqual("synthetic_sat", result["candidate_id"])
+        self.assertEqual("Synthetic SAT", result["candidate_name"])
+        self.assertEqual("PASS", result["status"])
+
+    def test_candidate_specifications_have_distinct_required_fields(self):
+        required = {
+            "candidate_id",
+            "candidate_name",
+            "discovery_sources",
+            "package_query_names",
+            "executable",
+            "version_command",
+            "dimacs_invocation",
+            "fallback",
+            "refresh_trigger",
+        }
+        self.assertEqual(
+            {"minisat", "cadical", "kissat", "cryptominisat"},
+            set(toolchain_smoke.SAT_CANDIDATE_SPECS),
+        )
+        for candidate_id, spec in toolchain_smoke.SAT_CANDIDATE_SPECS.items():
+            self.assertEqual(required, set(spec))
+            self.assertEqual(candidate_id, spec["candidate_id"])
+
+    def test_broad_discovery_searches_every_available_manager_and_fails_closed(self):
+        managers = {
+            "winget": {"available": True, "executable": "winget.exe"},
+            "choco": {"available": False, "executable": "없음"},
+            "scoop": {"available": True, "executable": "scoop.cmd"},
+        }
+
+        def fake_run(args, **_kwargs):
+            manager = "winget" if "winget" in str(args[0]) else "scoop"
+            stdout = "Synthetic SAT Example.synthetic-sat 1.0\nUnknown Mystery.unknown 2.0" if manager == "winget" else "synthetic-sat"
+            return {"command": " ".join(args), "exit_code": 0, "stdout": stdout, "stderr": ""}
+
+        with mock.patch.object(toolchain_smoke, "_run", side_effect=fake_run):
+            discovery = toolchain_smoke.discover_sat_candidates(managers, self.synthetic_specs())
+        self.assertEqual({"winget", "scoop"}, {row["manager"] for row in discovery["searches"]})

+            self.assertEqual("local_package_manager_broad_search", row["discovery_source"])
+            for field in ("command", "exit_code", "stdout", "stderr"):
+                self.assertIn(field, row)

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value

+            }

+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []

+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {

+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )
+    package_ids = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        value = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""

+
+판정표의 기존 판정 ID `SAT-MINI`·`SAT-CADI`·`SAT-KISS`·`SAT-CMS`는 각각 현행 후보 ID `minisat`·`cadical`·`kissat`·`cryptominisat`에 일대일로 대응한다.

+def _discovered_package_ids(manager: str, stdout: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return sorted(
+            {
+                value
+                for value in matches
+                if all(re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", part) for part in value.split(".", 1))
+            }
+        )

+        if value and not value.startswith(("Chocolatey", "Results")):
+            package_ids.append(value)
+    return sorted(set(package_ids))

+def _resolve_candidate_id(manager: str, package_id: str, candidate_specs: dict) -> str | None:
+    normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", package_id.lower())
+    matches = []
+    for candidate_id, spec in candidate_specs.items():
+        names = {candidate_id, spec["candidate_name"], spec["package_query_names"].get(manager, "")}
+        if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", name.lower()) in normalized for name in names if name):
+            matches.append(candidate_id)
+    return matches[0] if len(matches) == 1 else None

+def discover_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict, candidate_specs: dict) -> dict:
+    """사용 가능한 로컬 패키지 관리자 전건의 광범위 SAT 검색을 기록한다."""
+    searches = []
+    packages = []
+    for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+        if not manager_row["available"]:
+            continue
+        executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+        result = _run(_broad_discovery_command(manager, executable))
+        search = {
+            "manager": manager,
+            "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+            **result,
+        }
+        searches.append(search)
+        for package_id in _discovered_package_ids(manager, result["stdout"]):
+            candidate_id = _resolve_candidate_id(manager, package_id, candidate_specs)
+            packages.append(
+                {
+                    "manager": manager,
+                    "package_id": package_id,
+                    "candidate_id": candidate_id,
+                    "resolution_status": "resolved" if candidate_id else "unresolved",
+                    "discovery_source": "local_package_manager_broad_search",
+                }
+            )
+    unresolved = [package for package in packages if package["resolution_status"] == "unresolved"]
+    return {
+        "searches": searches,
+        "packages": packages,
+        "unresolved_candidates": unresolved,
+        "discovery_complete": all(
+            search["exit_code"] == 0
+            or (search["manager"] == "winget" and search["exit_code"] == WINGET_NO_PACKAGE_EXIT_CODE)
+            for search in searches
+        ),
+    }
